title: Broncos will have extreme heat to contend with vs. 49ers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos will have extreme heat to contend with vs. 49ers
sources.description: The Denver Broncos had a rough time at it on the road in Kansas City when the area was experiencing a hot and humid weather event. Now in Week 4 they’ll be on the road again to play the San Francisco 49ers and it may end up being the hottest temperature in that stadium’s history […]
